meta.name: writing-guidelines
meta.description: Review docs/prose for Writing Guidelines compliance. Use when asked to "review my docs", "check writing style", "audit prose", "review docs voice and tone", or "check this page against the writing handbook".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查文档是否符合写作规范
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要确保文档遵循统一的写作指南
copy.tagline_en: Check docs for writing guidelines compliance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure docs follow a writing handbook

howto.what: 安装后，助手会先从指定网址获取最新写作规范，再检查你指定的文档，最后按“文件:行号”格式列出不符合规范的地方；若未指定文件，会先询问你要检查哪些文件。
howto.when: 当你说“review my docs”“check writing style”“audit prose”等，要求审查文档或检查写作风格时触发。

say.text: audit prose，看看我写的这篇文章有没有违反写作规范。
say.note: 助手会先获取最新指南，再对照检查你给的文本。

howto.what_en: After install, it fetches the latest guidelines, reviews your files, and reports issues in `file:line` format; if no files given, it asks for them.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to 'review my docs', 'check writing style', 'audit prose', etc., or request a writing-style review.

say_en.text: Review my docs and check my README.md against the writing guidelines.
say_en.note: Fetches rules, checks file, lists line issues.

say_en.text: Check writing style for all markdown files in my project.
Audit this article against the writing handbook.
say_en.note: Fetches latest guidelines, then checks your text.
